style: Monochrome editorial still life, matte black, off-white and silver, tactile paper, restrained studio light. Landscape 3:2. No text, brand logos or people. Fictional illustrative concepts.

images.subject: An overhead editorial still life of off-white identity stationery, black embossed paper, a geometric black emblem, carefully fanned neutral paper swatches, a metal ruler. A visual metaphor for scope and craft, no currency.

Three different sculptural workstations on a charcoal tabletop: one solitary cube, three aligned cubes, a larger interconnected modular structure. Editorial physical maquette representing three ways to organize creative work.
Architectural paper wireframe website layouts and an elegant blank black laptop arranged in orderly layers on dark desk, soft side lighting, blank geometric interface shapes, no readable words.
Two related sculptural geometric emblems, one original circle with cutout, one carefully evolved circle with same cutout, connected by a folded white paper ribbon. Recognizability and evolution.
An abstract printed identity poster and a laptop with same geometric black and white motif, side by side, immaculate design studio still life, continuity between paper and screen.
An orderly launch kit on black table: folded off-white poster, a single business card, minimal pitch booklet and small blank website screen, one distinctive geometric symbol recurring without text.

One striking monochrome geometric sculpture repeated through a portrait poster, a landscape layout and a square art print, arranged as a sophisticated campaign art direction set, unmistakably same visual concept.

Three floating matte black product interface frames with precise white modular panels and one fine white connecting ribbon showing a task unfolding. Elegant conceptual software storyboard, not a real application.
A high end black cosmetic bottle with silver cap shown half as precise white wireframe and half as photoreal product render, neutral seamless charcoal studio, dramatic but restrained lighting.
A top down art studio desk with a neat repeating sequence of white paper folios, one black binder, metal pencil, contact sheets of geometric art. A continuous rhythm of creative production.
